title: How to Write A YouTube Script and Tell A Story
description:
In this video I share how to write a YouTube script that tells a story and keeps your viewers engaged. I cover the 5 plot points to a good story and examples of how I use them in my own cooking videos. A great story and script will help with your audience retention analytics and lead to a successful youtube video and channel!

end the viewer is left with a feeling or maybe even an idea that they want to take action on because of what they took away from the story the first major plot point of a great story is going to be a
